title.zh: rpi 0.3.1：同机实测——启动快 9.7×、内存小 4.9×
title.en: rpi 0.3.1: Same-machine benchmark — 9.7× faster startup, 4.9× less memory

summary.zh: 0.3.1 不改变 agent、工具或 CLI 的行为。本篇给出第一份可复现的同机实测：同一套 JSONL RPC 协议、同一台机器，rpi 启动快 9.7×、内存小 4.9×；并让每个 crate 在 crates.io 与 docs.rs 上正确展示。
summary.en: 0.3.1 changes nothing in the agent, tools or CLI. This post gives the first reproducible same-machine benchmark — same JSONL RPC protocol, same machine — with rpi 9.7× faster to start and 4.9× smaller in memory, and correct crates.io / docs.rs pages for every crate.

zh: 0.3.1 不改变 agent、工具或 CLI 的行为。它修的是「别人第一次接触这个项目时会看到什么」。

## crates.io 和 docs.rs 上的展示
此前九个 crate 都引用工作区根目录的同一份 README，其中的相对链接（`docs/architecture.md`、`LICENSE`、`examples/plugin-stub`）在 crates.io 与 docs.rs 上全部 404，页面上也没有指向官网的链接。现在每个 crate 有自己的 README，并声明了 `homepage` 与 `documentation`；docs.rs 对除 `rpi-cli` 外的所有 crate 以 `all-features` 构建（`rpi-cli` 的剪贴板特性需要 docs.rs 上不存在的平台库）。内嵌到 `rpi` 二进制里的文档快照也一并刷新，并纳入 CI 校验，不再静默过期。

## 与 pi 的同机实测
这是第一次给出可复现的数字。两个工具用同一套 JSONL RPC 协议、同一台机器、每轮全新的空配置目录，且双方离线；2 轮预热后测 9 轮，取中位数（数字取自 0.3.0 构建，0.3.1 不含功能性改动，故原样适用）：

- **启动（`--version`）**：rpi 17.9 ms，pi 172.9 ms，快 9.7×
- **到可用 agent（RPC ready）**：rpi 103.6 ms，pi 176.4 ms，快 1.7×
- **常驻内存**：rpi 18.6 MiB，pi 91.6 MiB，小 4.9×
- **安装体积**：rpi 23.9 MiB，pi 约 513 MiB，小约 21×
真正有意思的不是倍数，而是时间花在哪：pi 的开销几乎全在 Node 启动（`--version` 与完整 agent 只差约 3 ms），而 rpi 的 103.6 ms 里有 86 ms 是自身的运行时初始化。所以下一步的优化方向是惰性初始化，而不是把二进制做小。
完整方法、原始数据与未测范围（LLM 延迟、工具循环吞吐、长会话内存增长、TUI 帧开销）都在 `docs/performance-vs-pi.md`，基准脚本是 `scripts/bench-vs-pi.mjs`。

## 不用装 Rust 也能试
每个 release 现在附带 Linux（x86_64 / aarch64）、macOS（aarch64）和 Windows（x86_64）预编译二进制，附 SHA-256 校验。
en: 0.3.1 does not change agent, tool, or CLI behavior. It fixes what others see when they first encounter the project.

## Presentation on crates.io and docs.rs
Previously all nine crates referenced the same README in the workspace root, and relative links (`docs/architecture.md`, `LICENSE`, `examples/plugin-stub`) all 404'd on crates.io and docs.rs; the pages also lacked links to the official site. Now each crate has its own README and declares `homepage` and `documentation`; docs.rs builds every crate with `all-features` except `rpi-cli`, whose clipboard feature needs platform libraries that docs.rs does not provide. The documentation snapshot embedded in the `rpi` binary is refreshed too, and CI now guards it so it cannot silently go stale.

## Same-machine comparison with pi
This is the first reproducible measurement. Both tools use the same JSONL RPC protocol, the same machine, a fresh empty config directory per run, and both are offline; 2 warmup runs followed by 9 measured runs, medians reported (taken on the 0.3.0 build; 0.3.1 has no functional change, so the numbers carry over):

- **Startup (`--version`)**: rpi 17.9 ms, pi 172.9 ms — 9.7× faster
- **To a usable agent (RPC ready)**: rpi 103.6 ms, pi 176.4 ms — 1.7× faster
- **Resident memory**: rpi 18.6 MiB, pi 91.6 MiB — 4.9× smaller
- **Install size**: rpi 23.9 MiB, pi ~513 MiB — ~21× smaller

The interesting part isn't the multiplier, it's where the time goes: pi's overhead is almost entirely Node startup (`--version` and the full agent differ by ~3 ms), while 86 ms of rpi's 103.6 ms is its own runtime initialization. So the next optimization direction is lazy initialization, not smaller binaries.

Full methodology, raw runs and untested scope (LLM latency, tool-loop throughput, long-session memory growth, TUI frame cost) live in `docs/performance-vs-pi.md`; the harness is `scripts/bench-vs-pi.mjs`.

## Try it without installing Rust
Every release now ships with prebuilt binaries for Linux (x86_64 / aarch64), macOS (aarch64), and Windows (x86_64), with SHA-256 checksums.

zh: 同机实测：启动快 9.7×、内存小 4.9×、体积小约 21×
完整方法与未测范围公开，一条命令可复现
每个 crate 独立 README，crates.io / docs.rs 链接修复
预编译二进制 + SHA-256，免 Rust 工具链
en: Same-machine benchmark: 9.7× faster startup, 4.9× less memory, ~21× smaller install
Full methodology and untested scope published, reproducible in one command
Per-crate READMEs, crates.io / docs.rs links fixed
Prebuilt binaries + SHA-256, no Rust toolchain required

title.zh: rpi 0.1.22：无头 RPC 模式与插件安全
title.en: rpi 0.1.22: Headless RPC mode and plugin safety

summary.zh: 新增 --server 无头模式，让 rpi 以 JSONL RPC 服务运行而不启动 TUI；同时修复了插件入口函数的安全性标注。
summary.en: Adds --server headless mode, letting rpi run as a JSONL RPC service without launching the TUI; also fixes the safety annotation on the plugin entry function.

zh: rpi 0.1.22 带来了两项重要改进：

## 无头 RPC 模式
通过 `rpi --server` 启动后，rpi 不再打开 TUI 界面，而是以 JSONL RPC 服务的形式监听请求。这让外部编辑器、IDE 插件或自动化流水线可以直接与 Agent 通信，无需终端交互。

## 插件安全性
`register_entrypoint` 现在被标记为 `unsafe fn`，明确了插件与宿主之间的安全边界。这是一个 breaking change，但让 ABI 合约的安全性更加清晰。

## 其他修复
- 恢复渲染调度器和重载错误报告
- 中止操作时恢复编辑器状态，防止错误信息进入输入框
- ask_user 对话框支持 Markdown 内容渲染
- 本地开发模式下无 Cargo cdylib 时优雅降级为 skills-only 模式
en: rpi 0.1.22 brings two important improvements:

## Headless RPC mode
When launched with `rpi --server`, rpi no longer opens the TUI interface, but instead listens for requests as a JSONL RPC service. This lets external editors, IDE plugins, or automation pipelines communicate directly with the Agent without terminal interaction.

## Plugin safety
`register_entrypoint` is now marked as `unsafe fn`, clarifying the safety boundary between plugins and the host. This is a breaking change, but makes the ABI contract's safety properties clearer.

## Other fixes
- Restored render scheduler and reload error reporting
- Restore editor state on abort, preventing error messages from entering the input box
- ask_user dialog supports Markdown content rendering
- Graceful degradation to skills-only mode when no Cargo cdylib is present in local dev mode

zh: --server 无头 RPC 模式
register_entrypoint 标记为 unsafe
ask_user 支持 Markdown
dev-local 优雅降级
en: --server headless RPC mode
register_entrypoint marked as unsafe
ask_user supports Markdown
dev-local graceful degradation

title.zh: rpi 0.1.21：TUI 工具渲染与 crates.io 自动发布
title.en: rpi 0.1.21: TUI tool rendering and crates.io auto-publish

summary.zh: TUI 现在可以渲染工具执行结果消息并恢复会话历史；CI 流水线接通 crates.io 自动发布。
summary.en: The TUI can now render tool execution result messages and restore session history; CI pipeline connected to crates.io auto-publish.

zh: 0.1.21 聚焦在终端体验的提升和发布流程的自动化。

## TUI 工具结果渲染
交互式 TUI 现在能完整展示工具执行的结果消息，并在重启后恢复会话历史。这意味着你可以中断一个长时间运行的 Agent，重新打开后继续之前的工作。

## crates.io 自动发布
CI 流水线现在支持在 main 分支推送时自动发布 crate 到 crates.io，使用 trusted publishing 机制确保安全性。

## UI 对话框扩展
rpi-extensions 添加了对 UI 对话框操作 17 的支持，让插件可以触发更丰富的交互界面。
en: 0.1.21 focuses on terminal experience improvements and release automation.

## TUI tool result rendering
The interactive TUI can now fully display tool execution result messages and restore session history after restart. This means you can interrupt a long-running Agent, reopen it, and continue where you left off.

## crates.io auto-publish
The CI pipeline now supports automatically publishing crates to crates.io on main branch pushes, using the trusted publishing mechanism for security.

## UI dialog extension
rpi-extensions added support for UI dialog operation 17, allowing plugins to trigger richer interactive interfaces.

zh: TUI 工具结果渲染
会话历史恢复
crates.io 自动发布
UI 对话框操作 17
en: TUI tool result rendering
Session history restoration
crates.io auto-publish
UI dialog operation 17

title.zh: rpi 0.1.19：中止安全与多行输入稳定
title.en: rpi 0.1.19: Abort safety and multi-line input stability

summary.zh: 修复了中止阻塞工具时消息丢失的问题，TUI 多行输入和 Provider 错误处理更加稳定。
summary.en: Fixed message loss when aborting blocking tools, TUI multi-line input and Provider error handling are more stable.

zh: 0.1.19 是一个稳定性版本，解决了几个影响日常使用的边界情况。

## 中止安全
当你中止一个正在执行阻塞工具的 Agent 时，队列中等待的用户消息不再丢失。`PendingMessageQueue` 在中止流程中得到了正确的保留。

## TUI 稳定性
多行输入在快速编辑和粘贴场景下不再出现错位；Provider 错误信息现在被正确分类和展示，而不是混入普通输出流。

## 清理
移除了过时的 model catalog helper，减少维护负担。
en: 0.1.19 is a stability release, addressing several edge cases that affected daily use.

## Abort safety
When you abort an Agent executing a blocking tool, queued user messages are no longer lost. `PendingMessageQueue` is now correctly preserved during abort.

## TUI stability
Multi-line input no longer misaligns during fast editing and paste scenarios; Provider error messages are now correctly classified and displayed instead of being mixed into the normal output stream.

## Cleanup
Removed outdated model catalog helper, reducing maintenance burden.

zh: 中止时保留队列消息
多行输入稳定
Provider 错误分类
移除过时 helper
en: Queue messages preserved on abort
Multi-line input stability
Provider error classification
Removed outdated helper
